meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

copy.tagline: 规划配置计算流体动力学仿真，进行数值有效性与HPC安全检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做流体动力学仿真，需要确保计算参数有效
copy.tagline_en: Plan, configure, and analyze FluidSim CFD simulations with validity and HPC safety checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you conduct fluid dynamics simulations and need to ensure numerical validity and HPC safety

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你用 FluidSim 规划和运行流体力学模拟：选择求解器、设置网格与参数、检查输出诊断、重启中断的模拟，并在开始时校验数值有效性和超算运行安全。
howto.when: 当你想做流体力学模拟（如二维/三维纳维-斯托克斯、浅水、分层流等），或需要选求解器、配置 FFT/MPI、查看输出等时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 ns2d 求解器配置一个 256×256 的二维湍流模拟。
检查一下我的流体模拟参数设置是否合理？
say.note: 会验证数值有效性和时间步长等。

say.text: 如何用 MPI 并行运行 3D 分层流模拟？
say.note: 会给出 mpirun 命令和参数示例。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can help you plan and run fluid dynamics simulations with FluidSim: choose solvers, set up grids and parameters, inspect outputs, restart interrupted runs, with numerical-validity and HPC safety checks at the start.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to simulate fluid flows (2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow water, stratified, etc.), or need help with solver selection, FFT/MPI setup, or output diagnostics.

say_en.text: Set up a 256x256 2D turbulence simulation with ns2d solver.
Check whether my simulation parameters are reasonable.
say_en.note: Validates numerical validity and time stepping.

say_en.text: How do I run a 3D stratified flow simulation with MPI?
say_en.note: Provides mpirun command and parameter examples.
